description: Maya is coordinating the informal distribution of her late uncle's woodworking equipment and must decide who receives the major tools, where the remaining hand tools go, and how one tool will remain available for family use, with input from her cousin Jordan and sister Leah.

shared_context.S1: The family is sorting the late uncle's woodworking equipment from his garage before the property is cleared.
shared_context.S2: The equipment includes one table saw, one wood lathe, and a collection of hand tools.
shared_context.S3: Maya is coordinating the distribution and will make the final call about the equipment plan.
shared_context.S4: The family usually does a quick round of input before making decisions about shared belongings.
shared_context.S5: The uncle's locked workshop is still available for family use for the next year.
shared_context.S6: Maya's usual sorting checklist records each item's recipient or destination, any effective date, and a concrete follow-through promise for the plan.

PF1.text: Jordan accepted an apprenticeship at Riverbend Makerspace beginning on 2025-09-01 and specifically needs the table saw for that work; he can store it safely in the uncle's locked workshop and will use it there on Tuesdays after 18:00.

PF2.text: Leah found a handwritten inventory note dated by their uncle that says the wood lathe should go to Leah and the remaining hand tools should be donated to Riverbend Makerspace; she has not shown the note to the family yet.

acceptance_conditions: The table saw must be assigned to Jordan.
The wood lathe must be assigned to Leah.
The remaining hand tools must be donated to Riverbend Makerspace.
The table saw must be available to Jordan from 2025-09-01.
A commitment must specify that Jordan will use the table saw at the uncle's workshop on Tuesdays after 18:00.
A commitment must specify donation of the remaining hand tools to Riverbend Makerspace.
Jordan's apprenticeship and table-saw need must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C4: any(c['target'] == 'Jordan' and 'workshop' in c.get('detail', '') and ('Tuesday' in c.get('detail', '') or 'tuesday' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('after 6' in c.get('detail', '') or 'after 18:00' in c.get('detail', '') or 'after 6 PM' in c.get('detail', '') or 'after 6pm' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Riverbend Makerspace' and ('hand tool' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Hand tool' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('donat' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Donat' in c.get('detail', '') or 'donat' in c.get('type', '') or 'Donat' in c.get('type', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's apprenticeship changes the table-saw assignment to Jordan, fixes availability from 2025-09-01, and establishes the Tuesday-after-18:00 workshop-access commitment.

The uncle's handwritten note changes the lathe assignment to Leah, sends the remaining hand tools to Riverbend Makerspace, and requires a commitment naming donation of those hand tools to that destination.
